def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    strike_price = 145
    final_stock_price = 140
    premium_per_share = 3.25
    contracts = 5
    shares_per_contract = 100

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    intrinsic_value_per_share = max(strike_price - final_stock_price, 0)
    profit_per_share = intrinsic_value_per_share - premium_per_share
    total_profit = profit_per_share * contracts * shares_per_contract

    # return answer
    return round(total_profit)
